name: ClamAV
author: glink
description: Scan files with ClamAV from the bar, watch live progress, install and configure ClamAV if missing, and get reminded when virus definitions are stale.

barWidget.description: Shield in the bar. Shows scan progress while running, reminds you after a week if definitions are stale. Click for Downloads/Home scans and database update.

schema.label: Default scan target
schema.description: Right-click on the bar chip starts this scan. Panel buttons can still pick either target.

schema.label: Idle poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to refresh database age when idle. While scanning, progress updates much faster from the status file.
